fields.description:
h3. What

The Search field on the Work Orders page uses the design file's magnifier in List, Tech View and Board View.

h3. Expected

S1-R9a: "The filter chips and Search use the design file's icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it; this is the only change to List." The design file's Work Orders search uses the design system's own 20px magnifier, not Lucide's and not Material's.

PRD: [Board View & Tech View PRD v55|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030] (S1-R9a).

h3. Actual (origin/develop, 2026-10-15)

Search shows the Material search icon at 20px in every view. (The filter chips already use the design's icons; the Technician chip is SV-11326.)

h3. How to check

* Search shows the design system's 20px magnifier in List, Tech View and Board View, matching the design file.
* Nothing else on the List page changes.

From the PRD v54/v55 rulings on Bilal's and Slavcho's questions, 2026-10-15.
